name: leadfactory-oss
title_zh: 自带 23 个获客技能的本地客户驾驶舱
tagline_zh: 不用月付 SaaS，不碰云端数据。开源部署，从陌生线索到签约跟单全流程模板，附赠 23 个可直接调用的获客技能。
tagline_en: No SaaS fees, no cloud lock-in. Self-hosted pipeline from cold lead to signed deal, with 23 ready-to-run.
desc_en: Open source lead generation agency: local client cockpit, onboarding, 23 skills, business processes and agent templates.
why_zh: 把代理公司整套打法拆成可复用的技能包和流程模板，本地跑通，数据不出门，适合要掌控全流程的独立顾问。
why_en: Turns an agency's entire playbook into reusable skills and templates, runs locally, keeps data in-house—built for solo.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 B2B 线索生成与跟单流程，不含邮件营销、广告投放或 CRM 集成；需自行配置本地环境与数据源。
limit_en: B2B lead-gen and follow-up only—no email blasts, ad buying, or CRM sync. Requires local setup and data sources; skills are templates needing.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: Local client cockpit with 23 lead-gen skills
